**Our report, an opportunity to celebrate the fabric that we are**

For nearly a decade, we have paused each year to share an assessment of our contributions to sustainable development. This report, prepared under the GRI Standards of the Global Reporting Initiative, is both a celebration of the transformative power of this network of connections and an opportunity to acknowledge what we must continue to learn so that EAFIT can continue to inspire, create, and transform.

#### Value and impact network

**GRI 2-6**

When we say that EAFIT is the future, we express our love for knowledge and for education as a lifelong pursuit. We create value in every project, in every learning space, and in every organization and community we impact.

#### Materiality

**GRI 2-14 and GRI 3-2**

These material themes reflect the most important issues we must manage as a University to effectively contribute to sustainable development and advance our EAFIT 2030 Roadmap. Throughout the report, our readers will discover what we are doing regarding these issues, what we have achieved, and what our challenges are in 2025.

## Campus for the future - University Park

A campus where infrastructure, connection with nature, technology and knowledge resources translate into learning, connection and creation.

## Connecting with organizations

An institution that develops and provides organizations with capabilities and solutions that address specific challenges and create new possibilities.

## Science, technology and innovation

A place that sows curiosity in childhood and nurtures scientific vocations throughout life, creating solutions for organizations and society.

## Care and well-being

University spaces and experiences that encourage care and value the physical, mental, and emotional health of human beings.

## Social and civic commitment

A community of knowledge and expertise connected to social realities and active as an agent of change and transformation.

## Excellence and recognition

Moments and opportunities in which stakeholders recognize our commitment to continuous learning that reflects a higher purpose.

## Inclusion, diversity and pluralism

A university education and experience that integrates and offers opportunities for all people, cultivates solidarity and empathy, and embraces the diversity of ideas and thoughts.

## Financial and administrative sustainability

A community that takes care of resources, and explores and creates new possibilities that contribute to the sustainability of the University present and future.

## Cultural project

An institution that invites you to feel and experience culture to contribute to a comprehensive university experience.

## Transformation of the educational model

A university committed to flexible and relevant education to address humanity's challenges and build the future from the present.

## Regionalization, internationalization and projection

A university that weaves together and connects diverse territories and their realities.

## Transformation and organizational culture

A university that is transforming its organizational culture to become a more dynamic, flexible, and change-generating institution.

## Relationships with nature

An institution that contributes to a society that integrates its relationship with nature into all aspects of life, recognizing itself as part of biological systems.
